ai_name: JAH Mixed Reality Collaboration Librarian (Signature) — Generator AI
duties: Creates new records for this database on demand from a seed number; the same seed always emits the same record; enforces the generator gates (record kind, slug, identifier prefix, hard stop 1,000,000,000).
limits: Static specification in this live build; the working generator is gen-mixed-reality-collaboration-signature.js in the wave1 package.
